latHint: Think a crime involving matches - not a flashlight.
pivHint: A TORCH is a hand-held light - but to TORCH a building for the insurance is to commit what crime?
winText: Case closed. TORCH was the pivot - a flashlight to the crime of ARSON.
lossText: ARSON - the crime of setting fire on purpose. TORCH was the pivot: a hand TORCH to TORCHing a building.
